item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena, a 13-year-old student in a school in Pune, bathes daily, washes her armpits and pubic region, wraps her used sanitary pads before putting them in the dustbin, and asks her friends to do the same. Why are these practices important?

options.A: They only make Meena look neat and tidy, but have no effect on health.
options.B: They protect Meena's body from infections and also keep the community environment clean.
options.C: They are needed only during menstrual days and not at other times.
options.D: They protect only Meena's own health and do not concern the community.
